mentions.description: An ad-free, offline-first Android podcast player built natively with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, using Room and Media3/ExoPlayer. It is privacy-focused with no tracking or ads, and is currently in public beta.

mentions.audience: The author, who built it mostly for personal use

mentions.name: AudioWeave
mentions.description: AudioWeave is an ad-free, offline-first Android podcast player with a privacy-focused design that includes no tracking or ads. It is built strictly natively with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, using Room for storage and Media3/ExoPlayer for playback, and is currently in public beta with possible open sourcing planned.
mentions.problem: Existing podcast apps didn't satisfy the builder after switching from iOS, lacking a nice-looking, privacy-focused, ad-free option.
